name: GitHub MCP Server on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
description: Provides a private, managed instance of the official GitHub MCP server hosted on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore with Okta authentication. It allows developers to securely interact with GitHub through MCP-compatible IDEs over a private AWS infrastructure.
